kitEvidence.formula:
Sion charges Unstoppably in a direction for 8 seconds, turning towards the mouse cursor. Sion stops on colliding with an enemy champion or wall or on Recasting this Ability.  

At the end of the charge, Sion deals between [150 / 300 / 450 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [400 / 800 / 1200 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage based on distance travelled. Enemies close to Sion are Stunned for between [0.75] and [1.75] seconds based on distance travelled. Enemies in a larger area are Slowed by [40 / 45 / 50]% for 3 seconds.

builds.name: Decimating Smash: full-charge AD hit
builds.summary: Explore a large fully charged Decimating Smash number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large fully charged Decimating Smash number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 full-charge Q is 350 + 2.4 total AD, compared with 90 + 0.8 total AD on an uncharged tap. This large total-AD coefficient makes flat AD, Sterak's base-AD conversion and earned Hubris worth testing against lethality. Serylda is the sole percent-armor-penetration-family item; Profane active is not Q damage. HP does not directly scale Q unless an item first converts it into AD.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum target rank, game time 30 minutes, no elixir, dragons or allied buffs. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 900 current HP, 100 armor and 50 MR before any explicitly tested debuff. Owner starts at full HP. No free permanent stacks. Two seconds of uninterrupted charge completed before impact. Hubris exactly 10 credited kills with active buff. No E armor reduction or zombie passive, and no free Sion W health stacks. Absolute Focus active. Record raw potential separately from effective damage; do not count packets after the target dies.

kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Charging: Sion charges a heavy blow for up to 2 seconds.

Release: Sion slams his axe down, briefly Slowing and dealing between [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8) × AD] and [90 / 155 / 220 / 285 / 350 + (1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8 / 2.1 / 2.4) × AD] physical damage based on charge time. If Sion charged for at least 1 second, enemies are Knocked Up and Stunned for between [1.25] and 2.25 seconds based on charge time.
